sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, sitting top with 34 points from 16 games, host Shawbury United at home on Saturday 21 November (15:00) in what should be a routine fixture for the in-form leaders. Sandbach then travel away to Stafford Town on Saturday 28 November (15:00) in a potentially tighter contest against a side occupying 6th place with 29 points. Having won their most recent league match and showing a strong recent record of W-L-L-W-W, Sandbach will be eyeing back-to-back wins across both fixtures to maintain their title push.
divisionWide: Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals, level on 34 points with Sandbach but with a game in hand, face Dawley Town away on 28 November in a crucial opportunity to stay in the title race. The chasing pack includes Eccleshall (3rd, 31 points) who host Barnton on 28 November, while AFC Bridgnorth (5th, 30 points) visit Cheadle Heath Nomads on the same day. On Saturday 21 November, all matches kick off at 15:00: AFC Bridgnorth host Wednesfield Community, Alsager Town visit New Mills, Crewe face Cheadle Heath Nomads at home, Dawley Town host Foley Meir, Market Drayton Town entertain Stafford Town, and Widnes Town are at home to Brereton Social. Midweek action on Tuesday 24 November sees Alsager Town host Barnton (19:45). By 28 November, Allscott Heath (8th, 26 points, in excellent form with W-W-L-W-W-W) host Crewe, Brereton Social welcome Alsager Town, Foley Meir visit New Mills, Telford Town travel to face Widnes Town, and Wednesfield Community host Shawbury United—all fixtures carrying potential implications for the lower half of the division.
